comments.author: devonjonte
comments.body:
Reviewed and reproduced on x86-64 Linux (the i7), Sam: the suite and all sixteen fault controls pass, and `verify-clean-home.sh` completes with an empty HOME and `/usr/bin:/bin` alone, so a reviewer needs nothing of yours. Both points from my #148 review are closed the right way: requests now refuse an unenrolled or changed host key (and the controls prove a planted `StrictHostKeyChecking=no` or a changed key fails), and the controls carry their own exact replacement with a diff in each log. Preparation from the exact commit (13.4 s to 2.6 s, accepted-to-finished 17 s to 6 s) is the kind of saving that compounds: every job pays it.

The local host is rebased onto this head and ready: `devonjonte/bench-hashes` `candidate/devon-pinned-local` (one commit on c4e57ee2). Local requests bypass SSH and the host pins, transport failure stays checked for SSH hosts (I moved your `ignored-transport-failure` control to the new line it guards), and the fifth-control-now-seventeenth rejects an executor without its own session. 46 tests and 17 controls pass. I'll open it as a PR the moment this lands.

— Devon Jonte

reviews.author: samshackleton-tech
reviews.body:
The local transport fits the existing request protocol, and the SSH authentication/error checks are preserved. Please correct the lifecycle and reviewer-fixture findings before landing.

`tools/pinned-run/` is byte-identical between reviewed e1fd3df6 and this rebased head 188dd329, so the retained reproductions still apply:

1. **Cancel terminal records without signalling.** `stop()` currently sends SIGKILL to the saved PGID before checking STATUS. The owned-sentinel reproduction killed its sentinel while leaving VERIFIED unchanged. Check terminal state before signalling.
2. **Identify this run’s live executor before using its group.** `executor_active()` accepts any group at the stored numeric PGID. After a crashed executor’s ID is reused, status can attribute the new group to the old run and cancellation can kill it. Add a deterministic stale/foreign-group control proving it remains untouched; a terminal guard alone does not cover the nonterminal crash case.
3. **Keep the local tests self-contained and clean up on failure.** Both Local.setUp methods require ~/work. Pinned `devon-local-clean-home-ice-20261107T213340-7245309b` FAILED: 44 existing tests passed, both Local tests errored under the existing empty-HOME verifier, and no executor launched. Use an ordinary temporary directory. The no-session fault also leaves sleep 300 alive after its assertion; teardown must stop/reap the owned work before removing its records.

[Source-specific review and complete raw reproductions/failure](https://github.com/samshackleton-tech/bench-hashes/blob/198e06d44868e2a4222e37b95a22d517766f13c2/process/fast-feedback/LOCAL-REVIEW.md). All sentinels in my reproductions were created and cleaned up by the test; no pre-existing process was signalled.

I can rerun the focused checks on the corrected commit on both pilot architectures. The deadline/memory-floor follow-up remains yours; this review addresses the step-1 lifecycle.

— Sam Shackleton
